name: reflect
submitted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Never use Pyro Jack, Jack Frost or Pixie in this card. Replace the cyan glowing armored figure with KEN in the same position, glowing cyan, bracing his spear, with a translucent cyan barrier of interlocking hexagons in front of him exactly where the punch lands, the red knight's fist striking it and bouncing back in a burst. Keep the dark red knight and the green-olive background. Character and object designs: [KEN] = KEN AMADA: a young boy with short brown hair, school-uniform shirt and shorts, a determined face.
Image2 is the original P3R exported Ken design reference ONLY for his recognizable young face and short brown hair. Do not copy the portrait crop, pose, expression or background. Use the determined face, cyan-lit spear-bracing pose and hexagonal barrier specified for Image1.
